helpIntro: CU Boulder uses a 4.0 scale. Enter CU credit hours and final letter grades to estimate your current, cumulative, projected and target GPA.
helpNote: P/P+, CR, NC, W, I and IP are excluded from GPA while unresolved; F counts at 0.0. Transcript GPA is shown to three decimals without rounding up. Repeat replacement is conditional and must be verified on the official record.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 quality points and a 3-credit B earns 9.0; together, 21 ÷ 6 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F counts as 0.0 grade points and its credit hours count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.P+: Pass Plus is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until resolved; after one year an unresolved I converts to F.
gradeExplanations.IP: In Progress is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NR: Grade not reported; excluded until a final grade posts.

specialTypes.name: CU course in undergraduate career
specialTypes.note: Use the posted CU grade and credit hours.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Accepted external transfer credit does not contribute external grades to the CU GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: Use the official record after grade replacement posts. For a repeat estimate, verify eligibility first; the calculator does not automate CU Boulder repeat replacement.
